title: Western Blot Protocol
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sd7ea9n
materials: Groups of 10 female third instar wandering larvae were collected, frozen in liquid nitrogen and were homogenised in 2× lysis buffer (50 mM TRIS, pH 8.0; 300 mM NaCl; 2 mM EDTA; 1% SDS; 2% Triton X-100) with protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche 11873580001).

Blots were labelled with monoclonal antibodies to the β-subunit of ATP synthase (Abcam AB14730) diluted 1/1500, actin (Abcam AB8224) diluted 1/25,000, the NDUFS3 subunit of Complex I (Abcam AB14711) diluted 1/800

steps.title: Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge homogenates at 13,000 RPM for 30 seconds and collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare and Denature Samples
steps.instruction: Add Laemmli buffer to the collected supernatant and boil the solution at 96° C for 7 minutes.

steps.title: Electrophoresis and Transfer
steps.instruction: Run the samples on an SDS/PAGE gel and transfer the proteins to nitrocellulose using semi-dry blotting.
